name: NTA Corporate Number bulk (per-prefecture Unicode CSV)
note: Public form POST. First GET /download/zenken/ with a cookie jar to obtain the CSRF token (jp.go.nta.houjin_bangou.framework.web.common.CNSFWTokenProcessor.request.token), then POST event=download & selDlFileNo=<fileNo> with the same session. fileNo 27194 = national Unicode CSV; per-prefecture e.g. 27306 = Tottori. No auth/payment.

name: NTA Corporate Number Web-API (needs free application ID)
note: Requires a free application ID (id=<applicationID>). Returns CSV/XML per corporate number or diff. Do not call without an ID.

name: EDINET documents list (needs free Subscription-Key)
note: Append &type=2&Subscription-Key=<freeKey>. Returns 401 without the key. XBRL per docID via /documents/{docID}?type=1&Subscription-Key=...

name: gBizINFO hojin API (needs free token)
note: Returns 500 without the token. Enrichment incl. 財務情報 (financial info). Bulk CSV also at /hojin/DownloadTop.
